correctness.rationale: Degree-three coefficient space modulo linear functions has 2^20-2^10=1,047,552 elements. The exact second-polar antichain criterion verifies all 31 by 30 ordered pairs, via support masks for all 32 witnesses, yielding exactly 690432 valid words. Five elementary coordinate generators generate GL5; complete exact Möbius transforms and union-find of the finite valid set yield exactly nine components. Direct truth-table checks independently test every ordered pair for all nine representatives; group order and stabilizer divisions are checked. Every enumeration is exhaustive, not sampled; the complete standalone checker was compiled and run successfully.

originality.rationale: The complete nine-class orbit and 690432-word enumeration under GL(5,2) modulo output linear functions is a quadratic-sensitive classification absent from the inspected primary texts. Pineda Montoya explicitly reports no exhaustive orbit classification; the Khoruzhii–Gelß–Pokutta result discards quadratic parts and is not an implication of this refinement. Targeted published mathematical-record searches returned no matching stronger result; the 105 accessible own records included related but weaker dimension-existence and one-family witness claims. Unindexed equivalences remain a priority risk.

value.rationale: A complete natural finite classification of cubic Boolean generating functions satisfying a published nondegeneracy criterion. It resolves the explicit quadratic-extension orbit gap identified by the motivating paper in dimension five, distinguishing nine natural GL-plus-linear classes with exact populations and stabilizers rather than supplying isolated new examples. The full classification is motivated by the failed conjecture and twisted-quasialgebra second polars, and is not a routine linear renaming or subset of known third-polar classifications.
